comments.author: @tamaslukacs3173
comments.text:
Veszprém:
The City of Queens
The name originates from the fact that the city was the property of the reigning queen.
The English word "queen" has two meanings in Hungarian; here, it refers to the king's wife.
The coronation took place at the same time and location as the king's( initially in Székesfehérvár, later in Pozsony, and finally in Buda. It was always performed using the Holy Crown and with the participation of the Archbishop of Esztergom; if any of these conditions were not met, the king was not considered legitimate. ) For this reason, the father of Louis the Great, Carobert (also known as Charles Robert), was crowned three times.
The first time, the coronation did not take place in Székesfehérvár, as he did not yet control the city.
The second time, it was held there, but without the crown, as it was in the possession of the Aba family.
The third time, all the necessary conditions were met.
The Archbishop of Esztergom supported Carobert, so this condition was satisfied throughout the process.
